verdict.rationale: Metronome documents webhooks that POST to your URL for certain events, such as contract creation, thresholds being reached and invoice finalization. Subscription lifecycle changes like upgrades and downgrades are managed via the API, but nothing shows that each of these changes emits its own event. missing for 10: documented webhook events for renewal, upgrade/downgrade, payment failure and cancellation; webhook reliability guarantees (retries, signing, delivery ordering); independent corroboration.
